_comment: Copy to config/orchestrator.json and edit. The orchestrator polls every tick_interval_ms.

budget._comment: cost_per_event_usd is a rough proxy — we charge each hook event, not real tokens. Tune based on observed spend.

spawn._comment_2: Default targets `claude -p` headless mode. If your Claude Code CLI uses a different flag, customize here.
spawn._comment_3: Set dry_run:true while testing — logs what would run without actually spawning.

slack._comment: Create an incoming webhook in Slack, export the URL to the env var below, then orchestrator will post there.
